soundness_flags.label: ass:score-density and ass:holder-observed-law
soundness_flags.one_line: Both are labeled standard with ChiangKatoSasakiUra2021, but that paper's stated assumptions concern sieve approximation, basis growth, moments, and Gram-matrix conditions rather than a score-density lower bound or Hölder regularity of these three observed nuisances; cite appropriate nonparametric sources or retag the conditions.

soundness_flags.label: ass:known-allocation
soundness_flags.one_line: The condition merely repeats the declared definition pi_a(x)=P_obs(A=a|X=x), so it neither imposes nor formalizes that allocation probabilities are known; remove it or make the known-design input explicit outside the law-class condition.

soundness_flags.label: thm:wang-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed shape-free sharp region is not tied to a defined alternate compatible-law class: F(P_obs) still carries monotonicity and finite-L Lipschitz restrictions, so define the residual-continuity-only class and its completion before asserting sharpness of B(P_obs).

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:uniform-changing-contact-inference
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Honest simultaneous nuisance bands and the envelope/moment/entropy controls for the score process are assumed prerequisites, not delivered by the proposal.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The whole-set and VC-leaf coverage target is conditional on those stated nuisance-band and empirical-process prerequisites; the independent identification/computation kernel remains field-grade.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper observes iid (X,A,Ttilde,Delta), defines Delta=1{C<=T}, imposes consistency, overlap, and T(a) independence from A conditional on X, and derives CATE inequalities by differencing CAPO endpoints; equation (8) is its conservative upper CAPO endpoint.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 5–7, Assumption 2 and discussion; p. 18, Appendix A.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited paper formulates approximation, basis, moment, and Gram-matrix conditions and proves projection of its confidence region by linear programs; it does not state a Hölder nuisance-class or a conditional-density lower-and-upper-bound assumption.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1911.10215, revised October 2022 / Journal of Econometrics 235 (2023) version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes directional derivatives for fixed feasible-correspondence value-function statistics and a delta-method limit for those functionals.

The article studies inference for known directionally differentiable maps, shows ordinary-bootstrap consistency is tied to full differentiability under Gaussian limits, and proposes an alternative derivative-aware resampling method.
Theorem 1 gives a multivariate Gaussian limit and simultaneous inference for a supplied collection of point-identified subgroup effects under its assumptions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the Chiang citation on density/Hölder conditions with sources that actually state the selected one-dimensional Hölder density/regression class, and state whether beta is known; alternatively retag them as novel regularity assumptions with a practical justification.

Define a residual-continuity-only model and compatible-law class for the Wang reduction, then prove its own completion lemma so the box equality is a sharpness statement rather than an informal counterfactual regime switch.

Turn the inference handle into a mathematically specified estimator: define the nuisance-to-capacity map, score/orthogonality equation, multiplier statistic, contact-face rule, and the exact additional approximation conditions needed for the proposed uniform rates.

recommended_next_step: Revise the assumption citations/formal known-allocation treatment and define the shape-free comparison class, then retain this field-grade sharp-curve and changing-contact-inference angle for Stage 0.
